comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Two recipes are currently available from the male Resident NPC, just north of the Tavern.

R8 Sewing: Laced traditional hat manufacturing
5x silk cloth
10x lace

R10 Sewing: Artistic hat manufacturing method
10x cotton fabric
2x pearl
2x fine dye

It's getting late for me, though, and I think I've spammed the front page with enough data for the day; perhaps someone else would care to find out what they produce. Cheers, and good voyaging to you all.
